rules.attempt_001: Initial complete execution attempt across all 12 runs.
rules.attempt_002_conditions: Attempt 002 is permitted ONLY IF Attempt 001 fails to complete all twelve runs due to platform/resource failure (e.g., host OOM, platform timeout, unexpected container termination).
rules.attempt_002_scope: Attempt 002 MUST be a complete full restart of all 12 runs from the beginning under identical governing hashes and environment.
rules.governing_run: The first complete attempt is governing.
rules.isolation_and_combination: Partial results from different attempts are NEVER combined or spliced together. Every attempt begins in an absent namespace.
rules.terminal_failure_disposition: If Attempt 002 also fails to complete all 12 runs, the disposition is EXECUTION_BLOCKED_RESOURCE.
